title: MS St. Louis refugee voyage
why_famous: The liner carried 937 mostly Jewish refugees fleeing Nazi Germany. Cuba and the United States refused entry to most, and the ship returned to Europe, exposing the consequences of closed refugee policies.
route_summary: Hamburg to Havana; an offshore approach toward Miami; then back across the Atlantic to Antwerp, where the passengers disembarked.
source_title: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum — The Voyage of the St. Louis
geometry_note: The museum confirms the ports and sequence, including the slow sail toward Miami and disembarkation at Antwerp. Open-sea controls are illustrative, not logged positions; the ship did not dock in Miami. The line represents the documented voyage corridor, not a precise ship track.
